# Procurement: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Purchases above 5,000 must have two quotes attached, under Procurement Policy 3. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a buyer, I want the system to require two quotes on any purchase above 5,000 so that we compare suppliers.
US-2 As a supplier, I want to see which invoices are paid so that I can plan cash.
US-3 As a buyer, I want to raise a purchase request so that finance can approve it.
